build_hungarian_matcher: build a HungarianMatcher to match predicted bounding boxes to ground truth targets using class, bbox, and giou costs
build_sequential_matcher: build a SequentialMatcher that matches predictions to targets in sequential order by label index
build_lexicographical_matcher: build a LexicographicalMatcher that sorts and matches targets by class, area, and box lexicographic order
build_matcher_from_args: build a matcher instance from argparse args supporting sequential, hungarian, or lexicographical set loss strategies
review_hungarianmatcher_cost_matrix: review the HungarianMatcher _get_cost_matrix method to understand how class probability, L1 bbox distance, and GIou costs are combined
